videos.title: Flight Intelligence: The Power of Work IQ
videos.summary: Microsoft developers explain how Work IQ grounds AI assistance in organizational context and reusable workflow knowledge, then connect that grounding to practical agent experiences.
videos.why_it_matters: Agent usefulness depends on relevant business context as much as model capability; this walkthrough gives readers concrete criteria for judging whether a workplace agent can act with the right knowledge and boundaries.
videos.connection_to_brief: It complements the brief’s forward-deployed engineering, enterprise adoption, and governed-agent stories by showing the context layer those deployments need beyond a chat interface.
videos.connection: It complements the brief’s forward-deployed engineering, enterprise adoption, and governed-agent stories by showing the context layer those deployments need beyond a chat interface.
videos.verification: First-party Microsoft Developer video; sealed repository evidence verifies direct YouTube playback and a 14:34 runtime.

videos.title: Microsoft Copilot Just Got a Massive Upgrade
videos.summary: Kevin Stratvert demonstrates upgraded Microsoft Copilot surfaces and shows how the assistant supports a range of everyday knowledge-work tasks.
videos.why_it_matters: A hands-on tour helps readers separate broadly usable workflow improvements from headline feature claims and decide which changes are worth testing in their own work.
videos.connection_to_brief: The practical examples give a user-level counterpoint to the brief’s stories about enterprise Claude rollout and agent infrastructure, linking organizational adoption to the experience individual workers actually see.
videos.connection: The practical examples give a user-level counterpoint to the brief’s stories about enterprise Claude rollout and agent infrastructure, linking organizational adoption to the experience individual workers actually see.
videos.verification: Sealed repository evidence verifies direct YouTube playback and a 9:24 runtime for this established creator walkthrough.
